method: Reuse the exact local two-hop generator, GPT2-style model, tail/EOS supervision, dropout and optimizer. Only depth changes to 3/4 at width128.
paper_comparison: Appendix B compares model scales and reports fewer optimization steps for larger models. Our extension isolates depth at fixed width in the pre-existing miniature adaptation and reports steps, exposures and estimated FLOPs.
known_adaptations: FP32 with TF32 instead of original FP16
